missionPremise: OPS-18b Wave A2 / BP-ABSENCE-01. Sparse uniform rails become satisfied-absent only with the verified pair (evaluated true AND non-empty provenanceScope). Typed absence without the pair is the bypass (R-07 Q5d 108/1025 vs Q5e 0/1025). L7 Donley geometry is the proved pattern. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-21_a2-absence_dispatch.md, _inbox/2026-08-12_L7_honest_absence_close.json, _inbox/2026-08-12_L7_sparse_rail_absence_doctrine.md, 90_operations/OPS-18b_data_remediation_plan.md Wave A2.
completionPredicate: A stranger can say whether sparse rails can go honest-absent today without minting, quote the L7 write path against the pair, file:line each sparse scorer, name the starved pair on engine writers, name the unimplemented recurrence throw file, and name the first patch for one county on one rail. WDLL 4 graded from those observations.
scopeBasis: Read-only scout on property seat-worktrees. No product edits, no atoms --apply, no minting, no deploy, no git add/commit/push, no sub-agents, no COUNT(*) on atoms. Live GET figures quoted from OPS-18b (computedAt 2026-08-21T15:53:02.907Z), not re-queried.
whyNotToday: No checked-in scorer for rrc-wells / rrc-pipelines / rail-corridor / mud can emit satisfied-absent (all kind=unspecified; scoreRailCell throws). L7 facet-only writes do not require the atom pair, so copying L7 would close A2 by the Q5d bypass. Feeding the pair without minting requires a pair-bearing atom that the apply writers never persist. Mud leftover 45 are not absence cells.
